title: Mystery flying objects
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why are people so interested in unidentified flying objects even when explanations are uncertain?
What kind of evidence would convince you that a sighting was truly unusual?
Why can eyewitness reports be unreliable even when witnesses are sincere?
Should governments release all information they have about unexplained aerial sightings?
Would confirmed evidence of extraterrestrial technology change everyday life immediately, or mainly change science and philosophy?
